LUCKY TWENTY: L Ferraris stated that his mount weakened noticeably in the Home Straight but he could offer no explanation for the horse’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER DRAGON: Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running.  Approaching the 200 Metres was bumped by TOP TO SKY which shifted out under pressure.  Trainer M Newnham advised that the intention was to obtain a midfield position.  He said SUPER DRAGON jumped well today and was able to hold a more forward position without being pressured to do so, particularly with the early stages being run on standard time.  Sent for sampling post-race.
TOP TO SKY: Shifted out approaching the 200 Metres and was bumped.
LIGHTNING ACE: Became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters near the 900 Metres.  C L Chau reported that his instructions were to go forward which was consistent with its previous race starts.  He said when unable to cross runners to his inside he was obliged to race very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added that LIGHTNING ACE lay in during the race and did not run on when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BEST FARM: For some distance near the 200 Metres was held up behind LUCKY TWENTY which was giving ground.
TURBO JEFFERIES: At declaration time M L Yeung was declared as the rider of both BEST FARM and TURBO JEFFERIES.  It was established that M L Yeung had a firm commitment to ride BEST FARM.  As such, the Stewards permitted L Hewitson to be substituted as the rider of TURBO JEFFERIES.  For this declaration error, Trainer D A Hayes was fined $2,000.  Jumped awkwardly.  Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, TURBO JEFFERIES will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
BULLISH PRIDE: Bumped at the start.  Near the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded by SO MY FOLKS which was taken in by LIGHTNING ACE (C L Chau) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  C L Chau was reprimanded.
FORTUNE SUPERNOVA: Bumped at the start.  As a result FORTUNE SUPERNOVA shifted out and made contact with DASH.
SO MY FOLKS: Near the 900 Metres was hampered when taken out by CALL TO COMMAND, resulting in SO MY FOLKS making contact with LIGHTNING ACE.  Briefly crowded near the 800 Metres.  J McDonald reported that his mount raced keenly during the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  As this was the second occasion that SO MY FOLKS had bled, the horse is ineligible to run in any race conducted by the Club in the future.
EMERGING STAR: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with BULLISH PRIDE.
CALL TO COMMAND: On jumping shifted out and made contact with FORTUNE SUPERNOVA.  Approaching the 900 Metres got its head up and raced ungenerously when being crossed by TOP TO SKY which shifted in.  As a result CALL TO COMMAND shifted out and hampered SO MY FOLKS.  K C Leung reported that his mount raced keenly throughout the event and after being obliged to race wide and without cover from the 800 Metres was unable to finish the race off thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
DASH: Became unbalanced when bumped on jumping.
FLOWING RICHES: Shifted out at the start and made contact with CIRCUIT LUCKY STAR.  Sent for sampling post-race.
MASTER CHAMPION: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by CLASSIC TRIPLE.  Leaving the 800 Metres raced in restricted room between CLASSIC TRIPLE and CALA DEI MORI which lay in after being crossed by ZOUPER FELLOW.
REBORN HERO: Stood flat-footed at the start and lost ground.  The barrier manners of REBORN HERO were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, REBORN HERO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
CLASSIC TRIPLE: Shifted out at the start and made contact with MASTER CHAMPION.
S AND S GLORY: Withdrawn on 20.11.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter CURLING SWEET.  Before being allowed to race again, S AND S GLORY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
WINNING MONEY: Was withdrawn prior to the race on veterinary advice by order of the Stewards after it was found to have a heart condition which requires further assessment.
SHANGHAI WARRIOR: Shifted out and took a trailing position behind HANDSOME HERO near the 1000 Metres.  When the pace steadied near the 900 Metres then commenced to race keenly and when being steadied to avoid HANDSOME HERO shifted in, resulting in KACHOW, which was racing keenly and improved to the inside of SHANGHAI WARRIOR, having to be checked.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on SHANGHAI WARRIOR at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, SHANGHAI WARRIOR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CELESTIAL ZOUS: Was fractious in the starting gates, examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
KACHOW: Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the left side of the starting gate and lost ground.  Near the 900 Metres improved to the inside of SHANGHAI WARRIOR and was checked.  KACHOW then raced tight to the inside of SHANGHAI WARRIOR for some distance thereafter.
HANDSOME HERO: In the Home Straight lay in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HARVEST MOON: Prior to the running of the event Trainer W Y So advised that the horse would be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages, similar to the manner in which it was ridden in a barrier trial on 10 November 2026.  Bumped at the start.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  H Bentley reported that his mount became awkward in its action on the Home Turn and when he was concerned that there may be something amiss with it in the Home Straight he did not ride it out to the finish of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of HARVEST MOON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, HARVEST MOON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
VOYAGE CAPTAIN: When the pace steadied near the 800 Metres raced keenly for some distance thereafter.  Apprentice H Y Yuen reported that her mount would benefit by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SMILING SKY: M L Yeung stated that the instructions were to hold an on-pace position.  He said despite riding his mount along in the early stages it did not show sufficient pace to do so.  He added when unable to cross runners in the early stages he was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
NOBLE PATCH: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with HARVEST MOON.  C Y Ho reported that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAST TOP SEARCH: Became fractious when being loaded into the starting gates and as a result fell heavily.  Acting on veterinary advice that the horse was not suitable to race, it was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, FAST TOP SEARCH will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MIGHTY PROFIT: After being loaded into the starting gates reared and got both front legs over the front of the starting gate.  Acting on veterinary advice that the horse was not suitable to race, it was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  The Stewards ruled that MIGHTY PROFIT will be required to attend barrier practice to the satisfaction of the Starter prior to performing satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination before being allowed to race again.
KING OF FIGHTERS: When questioned regarding the horse leading L Hewitson stated that his instructions were to be forward of midfield.  He said when his mount commenced well and when he was caught wide in the early stages he elected to push on to lead the event when no other runners in the race were showing the intent of holding a forward position.  Trainer B Crawford confirmed the instructions issued.
NATURAL NUMBERS: Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up for clear running.  Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the inside of GOOD LUCK BABE to obtain clear running.  C L Chau (SHANNON GLOW) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that leaving the 200 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of NATURAL NUMBERS, resulting in NATURAL NUMBERS losing its rightful running and being checked when crowded between GOOD LUCK BABE and SHANNON GLOW.  C  L Chau was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 23 December 2026 and to expire on Wednesday, 30 December 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Jockey Chau was fined $90,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his poor race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SHANNON GLOW: Jumped only fairly.  After the 900 Metres improved to the inside of LET’S HAVE FUN when that runner shifted out making the turn.  When LET’S HAVE FUN then shifted back in to resume its position SHANNON GLOW was steadied to avoid LET’S HAVE FUN.  C L Chau pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference leaving the 200 Metres (see NATURAL NUMBERS).  Sent for sampling post-race.
REAL GENTLEMAN: Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LEAN GENERAL: R Kingscote stated that the instructions were to be handy.  He said in the early stages he expected GOOD LUCK BABE to shift to the rail and he would be able to take a position with cover behind the leaders.  He said when GOOD LUCK BABE maintained the one-off position he was obliged to continue forward leaving the 1000 Metres to avoid being caught wide and this resulted in LEAN GENERAL racing in a more forward position than what he had been intended.
RAGING WARRIOR: Jumped awkwardly and then was bumped by GLORY PATCH which shifted in.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the early stages raced ungenerously and lay in.
GLORY PATCH: Shifted in on jumping and was bumped.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1100 Metres was hampered when being steadied to avoid REGENCY DREAM which shifted out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
REGENCY DREAM: Dislodged its rider on entering the track, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Near the 1100 Metres RAGING WARRIOR, which was racing ungenerously, shifted in and away from MR COOL, resulting in REGENCY DREAM shifting in and making contact with SHANNON GLOW.  As a result SHANNON GLOW shifted in and made contact with TRENDY RUSH, resulting in SHANNON GLOW then shifting out and crowding the running of REGENCY DREAM which was steadied.  As the Stewards were of the view the racing manners of RAGING WARRIOR and REGENCY DREAM were the principal reason for the incident occurring, no further action was taken.  Approaching the 50 Metres was shifted to the inside of KING OF FIGHTERS to continue into clear running.
HAPPY SPECIAL: Approaching the 150 Metres SHANNON GLOW (C L Chau) improved to the outside of LEAN GENERAL when there was not quite sufficient room, resulting in SHANNON GLOW making contact with GOOD LUCK BABE and taking GOOD LUCK BABE out.  A short distance later LEAN GENERAL (R Kingscote) shifted out slightly, resulting in SHANNON GLOW shifting out further and away from LEAN GENERAL whilst being ridden along before Jockey Chau made some attempt to correct his mount.  As a result SHANNON GLOW again made contact with GOOD LUCK BABE, resulting in GOOD LUCK BABE being taken across the running of HAPPY SPECIAL which was checked.  C L Chau was severely reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he must ensure there is sufficient racing room to improve and when his mounts shift ground he is expected to make a greater effort to straighten them.  R Kingscote was advised in similar circumstances to exercise more care.
TRENDY RUSH: Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 800 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid NATURAL NUMBERS.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CASA BUDDY: M L Yeung stated that the intention was to ride the horse in a conservative manner.  He said when CASA BUDDY jumped well it held an on-pace position despite his efforts to ride it in a more conservative manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PI LEGEND: Near the 100 Metres was shifted to the outside of SO YOU IMAGINE to obtain clear running.  Near the 50 Metres PI LEGEND was then unable to continue to improve into that run when SO YOU IMAGINE and CROSSBORDERPEGASUS both shifted ground slightly.
LEADING ADVANTAGE: Shortly after the start was taken in and became unbalanced when it made contact with COME FAST FAY FAY.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
AUTUMN KING: Raced greenly throughout the event and lay out in the middle stages.  C L Chau stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, AUTUMN KING will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ROMANTIC GLADIATOR: Prior to the running of the event Trainer C S Shum advised that the instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages as it had not been finishing its races off strongly when ridden in a forward position.  Shortly after the start became unbalanced when crowded between IT IS YOU and COME FAST FAY FAY.
SILENT FORGE: S Osborne reported that when caught wide in the early stages her mount hung out making the turn leaving the 900 Metres.
GOUKEN: Raced keenly in the middle stages when being shifted in to obtain a position with cover behind LEADING ADVANTAGE.
IT IS YOU: Near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid SO YOU IMAGINE (A Badel) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  A Badel was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.  In this incident IT IS YOU shifted out when being steadied to avoid SO YOU IMAGINE.
SCORCHING LEGEND: Throughout the early stages raced ungenerously and near the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid ROMANTIC GLADIATOR.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  H Bentley reported that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages, similar to when it barrier trialed well at Conghua on 2 November 2026.  Trainer C Fownes confirmed the instructions and the reasons why he issued those instructions.  He added that the decision to ride the horse conservatively was also to endeavour to get SCORCHING LEGEND to settle as it had previously raced keenly in its races.
COME FAST FAY FAY: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied when crowded by LEADING ADVANTAGE which was taken in by SO YOU IMAGINE.  R Kingscote stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after being crowded shortly after the start his mount settled back in the field.
BRAVEFIELD: Bumped at the start with FAMILY JEWEL due to both runners shifting ground.  Near the 450 Metres improved to the outside of POCKETING as POCKETING commenced to shift out.  As a consequence near the 400 Metres BRAVEFIELD got its head up when being steadied to avoid POCKETING.
KINGSFIELD: Prior to the running of the event Trainer C S Shum confirmed that if the horse commenced well J McDonald was instructed to go forward as he was of the opinion there was not good pace engaged in the event.  Jumped awkwardly.  J McDonald stated that when caught wide in the early stages he allowed his mount to stride forward from the 900 Metres to avoid covering additional ground.  He added that KINGSFIELD lay in throughout the event.
SERAPH GABRIEL: Near the 1350 Metres shifted in and made contact with the running rail.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ENTHUSIUM: A Atzeni stated that after settling back in the field as expected his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAMILY JEWEL: Jumped only fairly and then made contact with BRAVEFIELD due to both runners shifting ground.  For some distance near the 1400 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid BRAVEFIELD.  In the middle stages raced keenly.
FORTUNE BOY: H Bentley stated that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SUPER GOLDENDRAGON: Shifted out at the start and made contact with POCKETING.  S Osborne reported that the intention was to hold a slightly more forward position but SUPER GOLDENDRAGON failed to show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so.  She added that SUPER GOLDENDRAGON did not travel well during the event and was under riding to maintain its position before failing to run on in the Home Straight.  Trainer W K Mo stated that the horse, in his opinion, may not have appreciated racing inside other horses and was disadvantaged by the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SUPER GOLDENDRAGON was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER GOLDENDRAGON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
RAGING BLIZZARD: Approaching the 400 Metres was briefly held up when improving into a narrow run between CRIMSON FLASH and SING DRAGON.  Sent for sampling post-race.
BOTTOMUPTOGETHER: Raced keenly in the early stages when being shifted across behind runners from the outside barrier.
SING DRAGON: M Chadwick reported that when he commenced to place the horse under full pressure near the 400 Metres his mount changed stride and when he was concerned there may be something amiss with it he did not fully test it out for the remainder of the event.  Subsequent to the race when being inspected by the Veterinary Officers collapsed which resulted in SING DRAGON receiving immediate veterinary care.  Unfortunately the horse was unable to be saved and was pronounced deceased by the Veterinary Officers.
GALAXY PATCH: Bumped at the start.  K Teetan stated that his mount commenced well today and he was able to settle in a more forward position than expected without having to make any use of the horse to do so.
COPARTNER PRANCE: Near the 300 Metres D B McMonagle dropped his whip.
BEAUTY JOY: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
LITTLE PARADISE: Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
STORMY GROVE: Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay out making the Home Turn when commencing a forward move.
VOYAGE BUBBLE: Approaching the 600 Metres made contact with MASSIVE SOVEREIGN on a number of occasions when being shifted out to improve.
NUMBERS: In the Home Straight lay out under pressure.
ENSUED: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  D B McMonagle reported that he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
KA YING GENERATION: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MASSIVE SOVEREIGN: Approaching the 600 Metres was contacted by VOYAGE BUBBLE on a number of occasions when that runner shifted out to improve.  Z Purton advised that he was satisfied with his mount’s performance.  Trainer F C Lor stated that the horse settled slightly forward than intended as Jockey Purton was required to cross GENTLEMEN LEGACY in the early stages to avoid racing wide.  He said this may  have resulted in MASSIVE SOVEREIGN finishing the race off only fairly over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SILVERY BREEZE: In the early stages was shifted across behind runners.  Sent for sampling post-race.
DOCKLANDS: Withdrawn on 21.11.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, DOCKLANDS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ENTERPRISE TRIUMPH: On jumping was bumped by SILK MASTER which shifted out.
CONTINENT EXPRESS: J Orman advised that he was instructed to go forward and endeavour to lead, similar to when the horse barrier trialed at Sha Tin on 10 November 2026.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed the instructions issued.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SUPER STRONG KID: R Kingscote reported that from the 650 Metres his mount hung out despite his efforts and ran to the outside rail.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER STRONG KID will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend on two consecutive occasions and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SILK MASTER: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Near the 250 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of BEAUTY OF POWER to continue into clear running.
STAY COSMIC: H T Mo stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
LEATHER HERO: Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with BEAUTY OF POWER shortly after the start.
NEGENTROPY: Jumped only fairly.  From the 650 Metres was hampered when taken wider by SUPER STRONG KID which hung out from that point.
GREAT LEGEND: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When being steadied to obtain cover got its head up and became unbalanced shortly after the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained an abrasion to its left hind leg and an endoscopic examination also showed a substantial amount of blood in its trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GREAT LEGEND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
PROVIDENCE: Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 350 Metres and the 200 Metres where it was shifted to the outside of CIRCUIT CHAMPION.
EMBLAZON: Slow to begin.  The performance of EMBLAZON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, EMBLAZON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TARGET AUDIENCE: A Badel stated that his mount enjoyed a comfortable run behind the winner during the race.  He said in the Home Straight TARGET AUDIENCE finished the race off only fairly and he could offer no explanation for the horse’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AEROVOLANIC: Made contact with CIRCUIT CHAMPION near the 50 Metres when both runners shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CIRCUIT CHAMPION: Made contact with AEROVOLANIC near the 50 Metres when both runners shifted ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FIRE DRAGON: Jumped only fairly.  The performance of FIRE DRAGON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, FIRE DRAGON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NOCTURNE: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Lay out in the Home Straight.
DUKE ATREIDES: M L Yeung advised that the instructions were to obtain a handy position.  He said when his mount jumped very well he elected to settle in a more forward position to capitalise on the horse’s good start.
